sourceQuote: An examination follows after one year study in degree program. Failure in this examination will rob the candidates of their chance to do graduation papers and render them into trainees, who are allowed to continue their study, or render them a completion of schooling.
targetQuote: 完成学位课程一年学习后，将参加考试。考试不合格者将失去撰写毕业论文的机会，并成为实习生；实习生可以继续学习，或完成学业。
